review_notes: I read the whole file. I grepped Mathlib for other uses of `SmallCategoryOfSet`, `SmallCategoryCardinalLT` and `CoreSmallCategoryOfSet`. The only use outside this file is in ObjectProperty/ColimitsCardinalClosure.lean. I also searched CategoryTheory for structures that might compete with these, such as category structures on subsets of a type or an existing core-style structure. I found none. `SmallCategoryOfSet` is a data structure for a category whose objects and morphisms are subsets of a fixed `Ω`. `CoreSmallCategoryOfSet` is a helper structure that carries bijections to a given category `C`. I know of no Mathlib analogue of either. `Shrink`, `SmallModel` and `Core` are different concepts. The two `exists_equivalence` proofs repeat the same construction. That is proof duplication, not a competing concept, so it is outside this rubric. I abstain.
